posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: "It won't work" is not a description of a problem. What doesn't work? If you see the background, you need to make it transparent, not color it in.

posts.author: Chiispiitas
posts.body:
2K3 does not use normal PNG alpha transparency the way the newer engines do.
You have to import the sprite through the Resource Manager, then click the background color in the preview so that exact color becomes the transparent color (use a color that is not present in your character, otherwise it will get deleted off your character too).
Also make sure the image is either a non-transparent PNG or a BMP file.

posts.author: Dyluck
posts.body: If the issue is that the Resource Manager is rejecting it (next time tell/show us the error message) or that it's not usable in the editor, it may be the format is still wrong. Open the image in GIMP or similar image editing tool, make sure to change the mode to something like Indexed or 256 colors, and not RGB, and then export as PNG again.

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body:
Same issue as last time - your image is 24 bits per pixel, and not 8 bits (=256 colors).
The keywords you need to google how to solve this with your software are "8-bit color" and "indexed color mode".
